checkpoints.name: setup_checker_failed_and_the_flow_went_on
checkpoints.description: The run's setup-violation checker wrote no state_out.json (a failed step) and the steps after it still ran and wrote theirs: LibreLane defers a checker's error to the end of the flow, so the run is a finding about the design, not a flow that stopped. Synthesis and the post-route timing analysis completed, and the run as a whole reads as violated.

checkpoints.name: worst_setup_slack_and_the_other_checks
checkpoints.description: The worst setup slack over every timing corner is a few nanoseconds negative and many endpoints violate; hold, routing DRC, Magic DRC and LVS report no errors; the design has 73 flip-flops (24 + 24 + 25, from the RTL). The slack is a range because it moves with every tool build.

checkpoints.name: worst_path_start_and_end
checkpoints.description: The first path of the nominal typical corner's setup report starts at flip-flop _354_ and ends at flip-flop _400_, and violates. The netlist names those instances, not the RTL: _354_ outputs src_b[1] and _400_ outputs sum_q[23] (the test suite pins both from the final netlist).
